title: Bee Removal in Irvington, NJ

intro: Dealing with a stinging insect problem in Irvington, NJ? The Best Pest Control NYC provides professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, carpenter bee, and ground bee removal services for residential and commercial properties throughout Irvington. Our licensed technicians locate the nest, treat it directly, remove accessible material, and seal entry points to prevent recolonization.
whyUs: Best Pest Control NYC brings over a decade of experience to Irvington residents, combining humane bee relocation practices. Our team — licensed or working under the direct supervision of a licensed applicator — understands the unique challenges of bee infestations in New Jersey's suburban properties and respond quickly to protect your family and neighbors.
localContext: Irvington's tree-lined streets and mix of historic Victorian homes and modern apartments create ideal nesting sites for wasps, hornets, and yellow jackets, especially during spring and summer months. Wall voids, soffits, attics, and eaves in older homes offer sheltered cavities where paper nests can grow undisturbed. Carpenter bees bore into the wooden trim and fascia boards common in Victorian-era construction. From properties near Irvington Park to businesses along Springfield Avenue, we've helped countless local residents resolve active nests in structures and on the ground.

faqs.question: How quickly can you respond to a wasp or hornet problem in Irvington?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day or next-day service for most wasp and hornet removal requests in Irvington. We understand that active nests near entryways pose immediate safety concerns, especially for those with allergies, so we prioritize emergency calls and work around your schedule.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Irvington?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: What types of stinging insects do you remove in Irvington?
faqs.answer: We remove wasps, hornets, yellow jackets, carpenter bees, ground bees, and bumblebees found in Irvington. Our technicians identify the species and use the appropriate treatment method — nest treatment and removal for wasps and hornets in wall voids, attics, and soffits; residual dust and wood sealing for carpenter bee galleries; and targeted treatment for ground nests.
